verdict.rationale: Moss is built to run in-process. It ships SDKs for Node, Python, Swift, Elixir and C plus a browser WASM build, and it indexes and queries locally with on-device embeddings and unlimited local queries. The docs, however, describe a cloud-hydrated model: indexes load and sync from the cloud and are cached to disk. A fully standalone local or offline setup is not clearly documented. missing for 10: a documented standalone local mode with no cloud dependency, a lightweight local server-instance option, and independent hands-on corroboration of embedded use.
